text:
The Tiki Totem was introduced in Desktop 1.2, according to the History section of the Terraria Wiki's Tiki Totem page (https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki_Totem). My earlier "could not confirm" answer missed this, and the fetch tool's summary didn't give a sub-patch number, so 1.2 is the most specific version I can cite. I didn't cross-check the Desktop version history page for a sub-patch.

CONFIDENCE: 65
